notes.title: CAPCOM GO! - Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Winter update for Capcom Go! Apollo VR Planetarium, featuring various updates, new content and bugfixes. For the holiday season, we have also taken 20% off of all our paid DLC items. 

[h2]VIDEO MODE UPDATE[/h2]

After receiving feedback from users, we have added multiple trailers and full-length planetarium shows from the NSC Creative archives. These can be played via the video console, which now gives users the ability to swap video tapes. We have included the following shows as DLC:

[i]ISS 360° Tour with Tim Peake[/i] [b][FREE][/b]- Explore the International Space Station on a guided tour with Astronaut Tim Peake, supported by the UKSA (UK Space Agency).

[i]We Are Stars [/i] [b][PAID][/b] - Ever wondered what are we made of, or where did everything in the universe come from? Explore the secrets of our cosmic chemistry, our explosive origins and connect life on Earth to the evolution of the Universe. Narrated by Andy Serkis.

Trailers for other shows created by NSC Creative have been included for free, with the hope that a future update will have these available for download. 

[h2]FEATURE UPDATES[/h2]

Various updates and tweaks to fixes were completed for this version, including:
[list]
[*] Ability to load different 360 video content.
[*] Drawers are now interactive and have interactive objects inside.
[*] Changed interaction for flip switches on Starball Console.
[*] Improved hologram shaders for Holoscope Console.
[*] Change music on reel-to-reel tape player.
[*] Added new Steam Achievement artwork.
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES [/h2]
We have also fixed various bugs for this version:
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions for various objects when thrown.
[*] Fixed Rift S and Vive Cosmos support.
[*] Added Rift S and Vive Cosmos controller mapping.
[*] Fixed bug found with subtitle switching on shows.
[*] General optimizations to lighting & environment.
[*] Made rubber band ball bouncy.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update and have a Happy New Year!

notes.title: CAPCOM GO! - Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to the initial downloads, we are flattered by the positive feedback so far! We have also taken note of the bugs and issues reported and have done the following for the 1.1 update:

[list]
[*] Split the download between the free version and DLC for easier access.
[*] Optimizations to visuals (especially visible in the Valve Index).
[*] Improved GPU and CPU timings, which should let users push super sampling further.
[*] Better performance for lower end machines.
[*] Minor improvements to the User Interaction system.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

We will continue to improve and bugfix as the project continues, thank you again for your support!
